content: The NAWO-DHAN scheme aims to provide comprehensive support to farmers, FPOs, agripreneurs, consumers, and landowners in Kerala, fostering a vibrant agribusiness ecosystem. It offers technical assistance, demand-driven crop models, financial support, and market access. Key benefits include increased income, improved livelihoods, enhanced food security, access to markets, training and support, and technology support for high-tech value cropping. The scheme also focuses on utilizing unutilized or underutilized lands for commercial farming.

The NAWO-DHAN scheme focuses on community development and social stability, promoting sustainable farming practices that enhance soil health, conserve water, and promote biodiversity. It aims to facilitate access to international markets, providing training, certification, finance, and logistics support for exports. The scheme seeks to explore vacant, fallow, and underutilized lands for hi-tech commercial farming in Kerala, with the Kerala Agro Business Company (KABCO) serving as the central coordinator for its implementation.
